description: This file defines the Sortable library, a JavaScript module for enabling drag-and-drop sorting of list items. It includes the implementation of the Sortable class, utility functions, and module export logic.

classes.name: Sortable
classes.description: Main class providing drag-and-drop sorting functionality for a given HTML element.

methods.name: _onTapStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a tap or mouse down event to initiate drag.

methods.name: _prepareDragStart
methods.description: Prepares the element for dragging, including setting up timers and event bindings.

methods.name: _disableDelayedDrag
methods.description: Cancels any pending delayed drag start.

methods.name: _triggerDragStart
methods.description: Triggers the drag start process, including support for touch and fallback modes.

methods.name: _dragStarted
methods.description: Handles the visual and state changes when dragging begins.

methods.name: _emulateDragOver
methods.description: Simulates drag over events for touch devices.

methods.name: _onDragOver
methods.description: Handles the drag over event, managing element repositioning and auto-scrolling.

methods.name: _animate
methods.description: Animates the movement of elements during sorting.

methods.name: _offUpEvents
methods.description: Removes event listeners related to drag end and move.

methods.name: _onDrop
methods.description: Handles the drop event, finalizing the sorting and cleaning up.

methods.name: _nulling
methods.description: Resets internal variables and state after drag operation.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Dispatches events to appropriate handler methods.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the current order of items into an array of IDs.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Reorders items according to a given array of IDs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current sorting state via the store option.

methods.name: closest
methods.description: Finds the closest ancestor matching a selector.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Gets or sets an option value.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes event listeners and cleans up the instance.
